title: US Homeland Security reports on moving robot dogs toward border patrol use, ForkLog says
summary: DHS published a feature saying robot dogs could patrol the southern border and reduce risks to people.

title: Tesla recalls nearly 54,000 US vehicles whose FSD Beta could roll through stop signs
summary: The recall, reported by Reuters-based coverage, is fixed by a software update that removes the rolling-stop behaviour.

title: DeepMind says its AlphaCode system placed in the top 54% of participants in Codeforces contests
summary: Meduza, citing The Verge, reports DeepMind's claim that the system writes new code from scratch but handles only competitive programming so far.

title: Public contract shows US Air Force paid Clearview AI about USD 50,000 to study facial-recognition AR glasses, Gizmodo reports
summary: The three-month study concerns airfield security, according to the contract cited by ForkLog.

title: US lawmakers present rules to regulate discriminatory AI, ForkLog reports
summary: The proposal, the Algorithmic Accountability Act of 2022, would require assessment of automated systems for bias.

title: Nvidia and SoftBank terminate the USD 40 billion Arm deal after regulatory challenges
summary: Nvidia withdrew from the planned purchase of the chip-design firm, which regulators in several jurisdictions had challenged.

title: European Commission proposes the European Chips Act to address chip shortages, targeting EUR 43 billion of investment
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen EU semiconductor supply chains and production capacity.

title: Intel agrees to acquire Tower Semiconductor for USD 5.4 billion
summary: Intel announced the cash acquisition of the Israeli foundry company.

title: Sony AI presents GT Sophy, a reinforcement-learning agent that beat top human players in Gran Turismo
summary: Sony AI reported GT Sophy, a deep reinforcement learning racing agent that outperformed leading human Gran Turismo drivers, as recapped by ForkLog.

title: AutoX says it runs China's largest robotaxi fleet with more than 1,000 driverless vehicles
summary: Chinese autonomous-driving company AutoX claimed a fleet of over 1,000 driverless robotaxis, the largest in China, according to ForkLog's 2022 review.

title: DeepMind reports a deep reinforcement learning controller that shaped plasma in simulation and in a real tokamak
summary: ITHome describes it as the first such AI to control plasma autonomously both in simulation and in a fusion device.

title: Nvidia says it detected a cybersecurity incident on 23 February; Lapsus$ claims it took 1 TB of data
summary: Nvidia said attackers took employee credentials and some proprietary information and that it saw no evidence of ransomware.

title: US Commerce restricts exports of semiconductors, computers and other high-technology items to Russia
summary: The Bureau of Industry and Security rule, effective 24 February, also added 49 Russian military end users to the Entity List, and several allies agreed to adopt similar measures.

title: AMD and Intel suspend chip supplies to Russia, devby reports
summary: The two chipmakers halted processor deliveries to Russia as Western export restrictions and sanctions took effect.
